integrity: Exact proof accompanied by executable, separately checked characteristic-two polynomial calculations and finite-field tests; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Proven for the generic symmetric bilinear determinant in characteristic two, n>=4. The square-zero nilradical description is restricted to the rank-exactly-n-2 locus. No primary decomposition at deeper rank strata or independent priority determination is claimed.
title: Frobenius-linear duality and doubled Jacobian cycles for symmetric determinant hypersurfaces
